author: Chandler Independent
title: Chandler CIVIC program applications open through Nov. 8 - NewsBreak
text:
9 hours ago
Mayor Kevin Hartke and the Chandler City Council are have announced that applications are open for CIVIC.
The CIVIC program is an interactive, 14-session course providing residents with a behind-the-scenes look at city services.
This free program will launch in January 2027 to help residents connect with their city government. During each session, residents will meet with city leaders, tour facilities that keep the city running, participate in interactive sessions and learn how to stay engaged with their community.
CIVIC sessions will take place twice per month on Wednesdays from 4:30-7 p.m. at various Chandler locations from January through June 2027.
Applications are being accepted through Sunday, Nov. 8. Interested residents can view eligibility information, the full program schedule and the application at chandleraz.gov/CIVIC .
Please submit comments at yourvalley.net/letters or email them to AzOpinions@iniusa.org. We are committed to publishing a wide variety of reader opinions, as long as they meet our Civility Guidelines .
